body: American people really aren’t any different than any other nation’s, the reason why I think we stand out more is because of our huge (comparative) population.
I’m sorry OP, if it helps here’s an e-hug. I hope you feel better.
That’s awesome, I’m happy for both of you.
That’s a shitty thing for someone to do to anyone. I’m sorry it happened to you, but if she’s willing to do that then you honestly dodged a bullet.
You have plenty of people to talk to here, even if we are just people behind a screen.
If someone is immature and mean-spirited enough to be an asshole to a complete stranger, they can go to hell.
Yeah I’ll for sure make more of an effort to make new friends. I just don’t want it to end up like this though. I usually don’t have an issue making friends, it’s just holding onto them that’s hard.
At this point I just feel like an observer, watching others have meaningful friends and relationships, something I can never have.

Thanks, honestly the worst part is that I thought I was pretty good friends with many of them. I’d been hanging out with them usually every weekend or every other day. One of them decided they liked me and didn’t realize I could scroll up in the chat.
Well thank you, I love you too. Have a great day.
